progression.narrative: The performance opens on Eb4 and dwells most on Gk in Pishdaramad. The line peaks at Gk4 (384.9 Hz) at 0:12.5. It closes on Eb3, not the tonic (Eb4 → Eb4 → F4 → F4 → Eb4 → Eb3).
